[attribute-xlink-actuate]
=== `@xlink:actuate` Actuating the XLink Link

The intended behavior for an XLink link when activated by an application, specifically, the timing for obtaining or retrieving the content of a link (for example, by a user clicking on the link to request the material, or by the material being automatically loaded with a document when the document or document component is loaded).

#### OPTIONAL on many elements; click for list and usage

<<element-abbrev,`<abbrev>`>>, <<element-app,`<app>`>>, <<element-award-id,`<award-id>`>>, <<element-bio,`<bio>`>>, <<element-chem-struct,`<chem-struct>`>>, <<element-collab,`<collab>`>>, <<element-contrib,`<contrib>`>>, <<element-custom-meta,`<custom-meta>`>>, <<element-element-citation,`<element-citation>`>>, <<element-email,`<email>`>>, <<element-ext-link,`<ext-link>`>>, <<element-extended-by,`<extended-by>`>>, <<element-funding-source,`<funding-source>`>>, <<element-graphic,`<graphic>`>>, <<element-inline-graphic,`<inline-graphic>`>>, <<element-inline-media,`<inline-media>`>>, <<element-inline-supplementary-material,`<inline-supplementary-material>`>>, <<element-institution,`<institution>`>>, <<element-issue-id,`<issue-id>`>>, <<element-license,`<license>`>>, <<element-long-desc,`<long-desc>`>>, <<element-media,`<media>`>>, <<element-mixed-citation,`<mixed-citation>`>>, <<element-named-content,`<named-content>`>>, <<element-nlm-citation,`<nlm-citation>`>>, <<element-pronunciation,`<pronunciation>`>>, <<element-pub-id,`<pub-id>`>>, <<element-related-article,`<related-article>`>>, <<element-related-object,`<related-object>`>>, <<element-restricted-by,`<restricted-by>`>>, <<element-self-uri,`<self-uri>`>>, <<element-std,`<std>`>>, <<element-supplementary-material,`<supplementary-material>`>>, <<element-uri,`<uri>`>>, <<element-volume-id,`<volume-id>`>>
|===
| Value| Meaning

| none| The behavior is unconstrained, and no other markup is generally available in
                        the link to assist an application in deducing the retrieval mechanism.
| onLoad| An application should retrieve the link at the same time a user obtains the initial
                        document load.
| onRequest| An application should only retrieve the link after a user has physically
                        triggered the retrieval, for example, clicked on the link.
| other| The behavior is unconstrained, but other markup is generally available in the
                        link to assist an application in deducing the retrieval mechanism.
| Restriction| This is an optional attribute; there is no default.
|===
